preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= ai_j <= 100 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each integer in the table must be between -100 and 100.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must contain the number of row spells and distinct row numbers.
The second line of output must contain the number of column spells and distinct column numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(table[i]) >= 0 for i in range(n)) and all(sum(table[j][i] for j in range(n)) >= 0 for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: The sum of numbers in each row and each column must be non-negative after applying the spells.
